summary: Iteration 66 — Frontend-only testing of confirmation modal flows for SpotYou join/leave/going actions. All 13/13 test scenarios pass. Both spot-you/[id].tsx and spot-me.tsx modal implementations verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation looks clean and correct. ConfirmActionModal is properly shared between spot-you/[id].tsx and spot-me.tsx.
The pendingCallback state uses setPendingCallback(() => cb) which is correct for storing function refs in React state.
testID attributes 'confirm-modal-cancel' and 'confirm-modal-confirm' properly set on TouchableOpacity buttons.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not tested - previous iteration 65 confirmed APIs work)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing pt_demo013 (Streetball 3x3 - République). NOTE: Test left user as member with isGoing=true at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All confirmation modal flows fully implemented and verified in iteration 66. SpotYou: join/leave/going/ungoing all trigger confirmation modals correctly. spot-me.tsx: going/ungoing also trigger modals. Backdrop click dismisses modals. Cancel buttons close modal without API calls. testID=confirm-modal-cancel and confirm-modal-confirm verified on both pages.
